name: argmate
author: Mathias Wulff
description: Fast CLI parameter parsing. Zero dependencies. Good DX. Pre-compile for extra speed.

scripts.build: bun run build-esm && bun run build-cjs && bun run build-types
scripts.build-esm: bun build --target node --format esm src/argMate.ts src/argMateMini.ts src/argEngine.ts src/argEngineMini.ts src/argInfo.ts src/compileConfig.ts --outdir dist/ --minify --sourcemap=none
scripts.build-cjs: bun build --target node --format cjs src/argMate.ts src/argMateMini.ts src/argEngine.ts src/argEngineMini.ts src/argInfo.ts src/compileConfig.ts --outdir dist/cjs/ --minify --entry-naming [name].cjs --footer 'module.exports = Object.assign(module.exports.default || {}, module.exports)'
scripts.build-types: bunx tsc -p tsconfig.json --emitDeclarationOnly --declaration --outDir dist/types && cat dist/types/*.d.ts > dist/types.d.ts && rm -fr dist/types
scripts.test: bun tools/generateTestsFromDocumentation.js && bun tst && bun run lint && bun run test-bundle
scripts.test-bundle: bun run build && bun run test-esm && bun run test-cjs
scripts.test-ci: bun run test-format && bun lint && bun run test-src && bun run test-bundle && bun run test-pack && bun run test-tsc && bun run test-cov
scripts.is-git-clean: (git diff --quiet --exit-code --cached && git diff --quiet --exit-code) || (echo Please commit or stash changes && exit 1)
scripts.is-main: test "$(git branch --show-current)" = main || (echo A release is made from main && exit 1)
scripts.prerelease: bun run is-main && bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun run format && bun run is-git-clean && bun run test && bun run test-pack
scripts.version: bun run format && rexreplace '(?<="version": ")[^"]*' $npm_package_version jsr.json && git add package.json jsr.json
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run build && bun run test-pack
scripts.postrelease: npm publish && git push && git push --tags && bun tools/release-notes.js
